title: constants.toml [tdma] guard_ms/slot_ms (100/250) diverge from spec 2a.2 and Rust constants (50/2346)
description: Found by kimi-k3 edge review of b7z9.29.1 (pre-existing divergence, flagged for awareness). constants.toml [tdma] sets guard_ms=100 and slot_ms=250, but spec/02a 2a.2 requires slot duration >= ceil(max PHY airtime 2295.808ms) + 50ms guard = 2346ms minimum (SF10 profile), and the Rust implementation uses guard 50 / slot 2346 (rf_health.rs / link tdma). The TOML file is the language-neutral source of truth per its own header — its values must match spec 2a.2 (2346/50), or the divergence documented if 100/250 was an intentional non-normative default for a different profile. Files: constants.toml (and any consumer deriving constants from it). Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.29.1.
